file: Tell Me Your Dreams by Sidney Sheldon.avif
title: Tell Me Your Dreams
author: Sidney Sheldon
description: A serial killer is murdering men, and the evidence points to Ashley Patterson, a shy young woman with no memory of the crimes. A fast-paced courtroom thriller about multiple personalities and who is really behind the killings.

title: Lady Joker
author: Kaoru Takamura
description: A group of ordinary men with grievances against the system kidnap the head of a major Japanese brewery for ransom. A sprawling, gripping crime epic about corporate power, the police, the press, and the underworld.

file: The Talented Mr. Ripley by Patricia Highsmith.avif
title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
author: Patricia Highsmith
description: Tom Ripley is sent to Italy to bring a wealthy young man home, and instead becomes obsessed with his life. A chilling, elegant study of envy, identity, and a charming man who will do anything to become someone else.

file: Eye of the Needle by Ken Follett.avif
title: Eye of the Needle
author: Ken Follett
description: In 1944, a ruthless German spy known as the Needle learns the secret of the D-Day landings and races to get the news back to Berlin. A tense wartime thriller that ends on a storm-battered island in the North Sea.

title: கொத்தாளி
author: முஹம்மது யூசுப்
description: மலைகளும் காற்றாலைகளும் சூழ்ந்த கிராமப்புறப் பின்னணியில், கழுதைகளுடன் வாழும் மனிதர்களின் வாழ்க்கையைச் சொல்லும் தமிழ் நாவல்.
